fusions.name: Fairy Ring
fusions.desc: Hyphae close around every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 12 plant damage and stunning them for 1 second, with a 50% chance per hit to leave them [Caged] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Oubliette Pod
fusions.desc: Fires a spore pod that deals 30 necrotic damage plus 4% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, leaves the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds and gives it Rot for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Rootbound
fusions.desc: Mycelium roots every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds and leaves them [Diseased] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Captive Decay
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your armour rises by 12%.
